short: Scale the lattice by the fractional ideal

lean.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.DV.NprimeDef
lean.plain: Scale the lattice by the fractional ideal
lean.note: The lattice $N_u$ is generated by products of a scalar from the fractional ideal and a form from the sublattice ramified at $T(u)$. The admissibility bound allows those products to have integral periods even when the scalar introduces a denominator.
